strings: After {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} got clarification, m_c understands what {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates were trying to tell {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
When a Clanmate gives m_c instructions piece by piece instead of all at once, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} able to do the task to completion.
m_c is no longer suffering from information loss.
